items.title: [AINews] OpenAI DevDay 2026: Dots, 6.1 Sol, Ultrafast, Decisions API, Agents API, Spaces, Marketplace, and 1.2 Billion ChatGPT WAU
items.editor_note: Longest feature list of the three and the 1.2 billion ChatGPT WAU figure.

editorial.tldr: OpenAI used its Sep 29 DevDay to announce GPT-6.1 Sol, computer use in the Agents API, cloud-based Codex environments, a Decisions API and new ChatGPT plugin capabilities. Simon Willison live-blogged the keynote from the floor.
editorial.whats_new: Latent Space's Sep 30 recap lists the full slate (Dots, 6.1 Sol, Ultrafast, Decisions API, Agents API, Spaces, Marketplace) and cites 1.2 billion ChatGPT weekly users.
editorial.why_it_matters: Computer use in the Agents API and hosted Codex environments move more agent execution onto OpenAI's platform, which changes where you run, sandbox and bill agent workloads.
editorial.take_for_builders: Do not migrate agent workloads to the new Agents API or hosted Codex yet: run your own evals on GPT-6.1 Sol and wait for published pricing and limits before changing sandboxing or cost budgets.

status.detail: DevDay products were announced Sep 29; the coverage here does not give GA dates, pricing or limits.
